Car Battler Joe.name: Car Battler Joe
Car Battler Joe.summary: Play as Joe Todoroki in his quest to become a car battler - like his father before him. His mother says he has the talent, but hard work will be the payoff. Customize a vehicle in the Garage to enhance or diminish its performance. Sign up for jobs, missions, and even tournaments as Joe explores the dangerous highways and byways that surround his village. Other car battlers fight for money and fame, but Joe has a higher calling: to restore his family's honor and bring his father home in Car Battler Joe, a racing RPG!

Oshare Princess 5.name: Oshare Princess 5
Oshare Princess 5.summary: Oshare Princess 5 is an Adventure game, developed and published by Culture Brain, which was released in Japan in 2005.
